decisions.reason: After several years without visible standalone support, its results likely sit only around aspiration, but because it extends the core web-mapping stack and is cheap to maintain, management would keep it.
Its niche character and lack of later visibility suggest performance below aspiration, so management would likely reallocate resources to stronger search or platform offerings.
Mobile usability remains relevant for customers and the component fits existing capabilities, so available slack and complementarity support keeping it despite limited recent evidence.
As the firm's flagship platform and strategic direction, it would be retained unless results were clearly far below aspiration, which is not indicated here.
Field data capture is close to the firm's enterprise GIS business and can support broader solution sales, so management would keep it while watching whether performance meets aspiration.
As a secondary search extension with no observed later promotion, it is more likely to be judged below aspiration and less worth carrying than higher-priority core products.
